title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 040 ]

blocks.text: Our parents cast long shadows over our lives, and we become aware of their existence when we are infants. Parents first teach us essential ways of living by cautioning, “Don’t touch” or “It’s not nice to do that.” We may think that we learn these lessons through independent efforts, but it’s not the way we obtain them at all. It is our parents who have given us our sense of right and wrong, our understanding of love, and our knowledge of who we are. As we grow up, we see them less and less. We leave their homes, and we start new families of our own. So sometimes we think that we can walk in the sun, free of the shadows. But still the shadows have not gone. We carry their being with us all our lives in the sounds of our voices, the look and feel of our skin, and the warmth of our hands and our hearts. It is only when they are gone and we never see them that we find that they and we are indivisible. In fact, we have not been able to separate ourselves from them our whole lives long. The shadows are still there, but they have never really blocked the light at all.

readingSentences.english: Our parents cast long shadows over our lives, and we become aware of their existence when we are infants.
readingSentences.korean: 부모는 우리 인생에 긴 그림자(영향력)를 드리우며, 우리는 유아기일 때 그들의 존재를 인식하게 된다.

readingSentences.english: Parents first teach us essential ways of living by cautioning, “Don’t touch” or “It’s not nice to do that.”
readingSentences.korean: 부모는 먼저 “만지지 마라” 또는 “그러면 못써”라고 주의를 줌으로써 우리에게 필수적인 생활 방식을 가르친다.

readingSentences.english: We may think that we learn these lessons through independent efforts, but it’s not the way we obtain them at all.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 우리 자신의 독립적인 노력을 통해서 이러한 교훈을 배운다고 생각할 수도 있겠지만, 결코 그런 방식으로 얻은 것이 아니다.

readingSentences.english: It is our parents who have given us our sense of right and wrong, our understanding of love, and our knowledge of who we are.
readingSentences.korean: 우리에게 옳고 그름에 대한 분별력, 사랑에 대한 이해, 그리고 우리가 누구인가에 대한 인식을 심어준 사람은 바로 우리의 부모이다.

readingSentences.english: As we grow up, we see them less and less.
readingSentences.korean: 성장함에 따라 우리는 부모를 점점 덜 만나게 된다.

readingSentences.english: We leave their homes, and we start new families of our own.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 부모의 집을 떠나 우리 자신만의 새로운 가정을 꾸린다.

readingSentences.english: So sometimes we think that we can walk in the sun, free of the shadows.
readingSentences.korean: 그래서 때때로 우리는 그 그림자에서 벗어나 햇볕 속을 당당히 걸을 수 있다고 생각한다.

readingSentences.english: But still the shadows have not gone.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 여전히 그 그림자는 사라지지 않았다.

readingSentences.english: We carry their being with us all our lives in the sounds of our voices, the look and feel of our skin, and the warmth of our hands and our hearts.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 목소리의 울림, 피부의 모습과 촉감, 그리고 손과 가슴의 따스함 속에 평생 동안 부모의 존재를 간직하고 살아간다.

readingSentences.english: It is only when they are gone and we never see them that we find that they and we are indivisible.
readingSentences.korean: 부모가 세상을 떠나 결코 다시 볼 수 없게 되었을 때에야 우리는 부모와 우리가 결코 나뉠 수 없는 하나임을 깨닫게 된다.

readingSentences.english: In fact, we have not been able to separate ourselves from them our whole lives long.
readingSentences.korean: 사실 우리는 평생 동안 부모로부터 우리 자신을 결코 떼어놓을 수 없었던 것이다.

readingSentences.english: The shadows are still there, but they have never really blocked the light at all.
readingSentences.korean: 그 그림자는 여전히 그곳에 남아 있지만, 결코 우리의 빛을 가린 적이 없었다.
